description: This line plot illustrates how the minimum ADE₂₀ metric, measured in meters, changes across different values of the ratio parameter, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, for five distinct methods: TrajICL, Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64. The x-axis is labeled "Ratio" and uses a linear scale. The y-axis is labeled "minADE₂₀ (m)" and also uses a linear scale, spanning from approximately 0.55 to 0.78. The "TrajICL" method is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, remaining relatively flat around 0.60. The "Head Tuning" method is shown as an orange line with triangle markers, starting at approximately 0.78 and decreasing to about 0.69. The "FT" method is depicted by a green line with square markers, beginning at around 0.69 and steadily declining to approximately 0.53. The "LoRA 16" method is represented by a red line with diamond markers, starting near 0.74 and decreasing to about 0.60. The "LoRA 64" method is shown as a purple line with pentagon markers, starting at approximately 0.74 and decreasing to around 0.60. All lines show a general downward trend as the ratio increases, with the "FT" method showing the steepest decline.
